tb21_profile.skill: Bring up a fussy source build end to end: detect the host OS/ISA and pass the right configure target, satisfy pinned toolchain dependencies (OCaml/opam/Coq/menhir versions), read configure and link failures back to their cause, and land a working binary at an exact path
tb21_profile.domain: native compiler toolchains and source packaging - configure/make, autotools/meson/CMake, cross-toolchain prefixes, OCaml and Coq for CompCert specifically
tb21_profile.task_form: build/packaging: no code to write, just make a large third-party project compile and run

verifier_notes: The packet's inline `verifier` field and work/verifier_strength.json disagree on 2,677 of 9,968 shown candidates across the v2 packets (verifier_strength.json is 5 minutes newer and regrades most of the FREE ones upward: 626 FREE in the packets vs 85 in the file). For compile-compcert this matters a lot - tw_289380, tw_694280, tw_30439 and tw_137314 read FREE in the packet but strong in the file. I applied the union rule: nothing that either source calls FREE is in final_top10, so tw_289380 and its siblings are excluded even though the newer grading clears them. The merge step should decide which grading is authoritative; if it is verifier_strength.json, several TerminalWorld build tasks become usable that I left out.

notes: This TB2.1 task has no OCaml/Coq neighbour worth the name - `tools.py search all` for OCaml|opam|Coq|menhir returns five hits pool-wide, all QCheck hello-world tasks, and the only Coq task anywhere is CalibForge's software-engineering_20260510_062946_019 (writing proofs, not building a Coq project). So every list is ranked on the build/packaging skill instead of the language. CalibForge is outstanding here: it has a large, strongly-verified 'build package X from source, static or with feature Y, install to exact path, binary must run' family that retrieval mostly missed. TerminalWorld is far better than its shortlist suggests - the shortlist surfaced its FREE-graded build tasks while tw_6033 (cross-compiler prefix), tw_135422 (LFS cross-toolchain) and tw_204493 (bootstrap deps on CentOS 7) had to be found by searching. Recursive-Task-Synthesis is dominated by three near-duplicate PostgreSQL-from-source variants; I kept three because the family genuinely is its best answer, but a merge should probably take only one. SWE-Smith's conan cluster is the single best domain match for 'configure a build for this OS and ISA' even though its task_form is a Python bug fix; I scored it high on skill/domain and low on form deliberately. See verifier_notes for a packet-vs-file grading discrepancy that affects several TerminalWorld candidates.
